title: SATS guided meditation for sleep · Neville Goddard's state akin to sleep, whispered (49 min)
description:
A guided, whispered sleep meditation built on Neville Goddard's state akin to sleep: a short plain explanation, a few lines from the public-domain books, then a long, quiet stretch to fall asleep in the wish fulfilled.
The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.
49 min of soft whispering over a slow, dim painting that grows stroke by stroke, no music.

Chapters
0:00:00 An hour of Neville Goddard's state akin to sleep, whispered 
0:01:59 You are lying comfortably in your soft bed now
0:10:13 You are lying in your bed now
0:31:54 You are lying in bed

Techniques from the public-domain writings of Neville Goddard (1905–1972).
Quoted from: Feeling Is the Secret (1944); Out of This World (1949), public domain in the US.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by any estate, publisher or organisation.
A practice for rest and imagination, not a promise of any outcome.
